stem.text: Which statement about the Michaelis–Menten constant ($K_\text{m}$) is correct for an enzyme with a low affinity for its substrate?

A.text: It has a high $K_\text{m}$ and reaches $V_\text{max}$ at a high substrate concentration.

B.text: It has a high $K_\text{m}$ and reaches $V_\text{max}$ at a low substrate concentration.

C.text: It has a low $K_\text{m}$ and reaches $V_\text{max}$ at a high substrate concentration.

D.text: It has a low $K_\text{m}$ and reaches $V_\text{max}$ at a low substrate concentration.
